test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Five friends Mahi, Mili, Milan, Manas, and Monika sit on a bench facing north. Only Mahi is sitting between Mili and Monika. Manas sits to the immediate left of Mili. Manas is not at the end. Who sits to the immediate right of Milan?
solution:
**Given :** Five friends Mahi, Mili, Milan, Manas, and Monika sit on a bench facing north.

**Explanation :**

1) Only Mahi is sitting between Mili and Monika.

2) Manas sits to the immediate left of Mili.

As position of Mahi is not known yet, therefore there are two possible positions.

After positioning Mahi, Mili, Monika and Manas only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e Milan.

 
• Case - (1) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/502d239419cf69c1617807247087290dbddddf433f2899dd0438c996cae70af4.png] 

 
• Case - (2) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8552cb4175b7c52ca1b9420dd90df43b1c8db9e9799176db705a82847f3ec942.png] 

3) Manas is not at the end.

As Manas cannot be positioned at any of the ends, therefore case - (1) is eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8552cb4175b7c52ca1b9420dd90df43b1c8db9e9799176db705a82847f3ec942.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement Manas sits to the immediate right of Milan.

Hence, **"Manas"** is the correct answer.
